newsitem.title: ITALY: CIR Olivetti stake down at 9.3pct.
newsitem.headline: CIR Olivetti stake down at 9.3pct.

text.p: De Benedetti industrial holding CIR said in a statement it had sold shares in Italian information technology group Olivetti on the market, bringing its current stake down to 9.3 percent.
CIR's stake in Olivetti, from which Carlo De Benedetti stepped down as chairman last September, stood at 12.8 percent at the end of 1996, down from 14.5 percent in June, it said.
"The sales were made in a gradual way in the course of the past few weeks in the context of a market with high volumes and improving prices," it said.
"The operations carried out come with the programme of a reduction of CIR's stake in Olivetti, in keeping with statements made by the Engineer Carlo De Benedetti," it said.
CIR is De Benedetti's industrial holding, and is controlled by his financial holding Cofide.
CIR said that as a result of divestments made in 1996 its consolidated turnover was 3.8 trillion lire. It gave no comparison.
CIR shares closed 2.34 percent up on the day at 1,183 lire.
